decision: Scoped reading-layout change passes independent source, retained-screenshot and browser-evidence review. No unresolved P1/P2 finding.

diff_scope.result: Removing the one inserted context reading block recreates the entire published baseline stylesheet exactly after newline normalization.
diff_scope.scope: Only .n-sec[aria-labelledby="nContext"] and its descendants; no general nation names, facts, directory, game or appearance controls changed.
diff_scope.new_css_or_js_assets: No new dependency or JavaScript in this change; standard stylesheet build remains required.

evidence_assessment.finding: Personally viewed full desktop before/after screenshots and the latest phone after screenshot. Distinct sans-serif history subsections and visible whitespace resolve the baseline crowded hierarchy. Full headings and body text remain present; the phone image is a scrolled excerpt, not a complete-page capture.

Root-retained actual browser metrics report 12px heading/body and body/receipt gaps, and 32px between a receipt and the next subsection. CSS tokens define the same 12/32px values. Baseline zero-gap rows match the before screenshot.

CSS changes neither source URLs nor DOM content. Semantic h2/h3, note text, dated receipts, source anchors and screen-reader new-tab labels remain in Context output. New 44px minimum applies to own-resource links inside this context section; existing inline fact-citation and related-record links are not newly certified as 44px targets.

Retained root-browser measurements show no horizontal overflow at 320,390,768,1280px viewport widths and own-resource link rectangles at least44px tall. These are actual desktop-browser viewport measurements, not reviewer reruns or physical-device certification.

No color, theme, animation, transition, focus, hidden-state or name-font rule changed. The new h3 style uses the existing reading font. Static current-token contrast for body, links and receipts exceeds4.5 in all four appearances. Root browser switched four appearances; UI Still was selected. No OS reduced-motion emulation is claimed.

Native source anchors and existing :focus-visible rule remain intact; no display:none, visibility, pointer-events or tab-order changes added. This source review is not a fresh end-to-end keyboard or screen-reader test.

retained_browser_scope: Actual in-app desktop browser responsive viewport checks, not physical-device or screen-reader certification; Still motion preference selected through UI, not OS reduced-motion emulation.
limits: Reviewer assessed actual retained root browser evidence and screenshots; no new browser operations or live source fetches performed.
Southern Ute page is the measured layout fixture. This does not certify every Nation page, language, assistive technology, physical phone or browser engine.
Source presence and focus rules are preserved at source level; no independent screen-reader or fresh keyboard interaction certification.
Normal build, font/copy/contrast checks and reviewed publication must still pass.
